scenes.text: Connect everyday discounts, participation and surveys to percentages; always identify the whole.
Find 10 percent of 80. The answer is 8. 10 percent equals 10/100, so 80 times 10/100 equals 8.
A group in a craft workshop has 60 learners; 10 percent joined an activity. How many joined? Pause the video and think.
A group in a craft workshop has 60 learners; 10 percent joined an activity. How many joined? The answer is 6. 10 percent equals 10/100, so 60 times 10/100 equals 6.
